notes: Identical small sample, not overall catalogue coverage.
SK/CZ domains isolated; cross-domain fallback is not counted as success.

scope: A fixed small sample and current parser/request behavior, not a service-wide catalogue-coverage measurement.
limitations: SuperMusic search pages were received, but candidate song pages returned a JavaScript intermediate; four search pages remained unverified. No missing-catalogue conclusion is made.
KaraokeTexty SK/CZ domains are isolated, so cross-domain fallback cannot inflate their counts. Seven successful texts had identical hashes across both domains.
Both KaraokeTexty variants returned unrecognized markup for the two English recordings. This is not evidence that the site lacks their lyrics.
Local network failures are recorded separately and must not be interpreted as catalogue misses.
SuperMusic diagnostic parser is conservative and not a production adapter.
